theme_strategy.description: A sophisticated, high-energy aesthetic that replaces the dated 'arcade neon' with a modern streaming-service UI feel (e.g., Apple TV+ meets Jackbox). It relies on deep midnight backgrounds, tactile components with colored shadows, and smooth glassmorphism rather than flat glowing boxes.
theme_strategy.tv_specifics: 10-foot UI optimized. Requires 5% safe zone padding around the screen. Avoids pure black to prevent OLED smearing; uses rich dark slate. D-pad focus states must be unmissable.
theme_strategy.phone_specifics: High-contrast, large tap targets, tactile feedback. Must feel like a premium remote control.

rules: TV minimum font size is 24px (text-2xl). Never use smaller text.
Use 'Space Mono' for Room Codes and the Phone Number Pad to retain a game-show vibe without the harshness of JetBrains Mono.
Apply 'tracking-widest' to the Room Code for legibility.
Replace electric cyan and hot pink with rich Luminous Coral (--primary) and Deep Indigo (--secondary).
Use gradients sparingly, primarily on the Buzzer or Podiums.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10' for TV panels, option cards, and floating UI. This creates depth against the dark background.
visual_enhancers.tactile_shadows: Instead of black drop shadows, use colored ambient shadows for active states (e.g., 'shadow-[0_0_40px_var(--primary-glow)]').
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Apply a very subtle 2-3% opacity white noise overlay to the TV background to eliminate banding on large screens and add a premium studio feel.

layouts_and_grids.tv_lobby: Use Mode A 'Bento Grid Protocol'. Asymmetrical. QR Code + Room Code in a large 'Hero' block (col-span-4). Game modes and categories in smaller interlocking blocks.
layouts_and_grids.tv_question_phase: Use a focused layout. Top: Question + Timer pill. Center: 2x2 grid for Option Cards. For Picture rounds: Split screen (Left: Image, Right: vertical stack of options).
layouts_and_grids.phone_answer_grid: Full-height 2x2 grid taking up the entire screen below the header for multiple choice. Massive tap areas.
layouts_and_grids.phone_number_pad: Standard 3x4 dialer grid, no gaps, subtle borders.

tv_dpad_focus.description: CRITICAL: TV UI must clearly show what is focused.
tv_dpad_focus.styles: scale-105 ring-4 ring-white ring-offset-4 ring-offset-[#0B0E14] z-50 transition-all duration-200

option_cards.tv: Glassmorphism base. A/B/C/D labels are large, absolute positioned, text-white/20 font-mono.
option_cards.phone: Solid #1A202C base. Active/Selected state inverts to Solid --primary. Correct state flashes --success.
option_cards.reveal: Correct option scales up 1.05 and turns --success green. Wrong options dim to opacity-30 and scale down 0.95.

phone_buzzer.styles: rounded-full aspect-square w-64 mx-auto bg-gradient-to-b from-orange-400 to-orange-600 shadow-[0_12px_0_#C2410C,0_20px_40px_rgba(249,115,22,0.4)] active:translate-y-3 active:shadow-[0_0px_0_#C2410C,0_0px_0px_rgba(249,115,22,0)] transition-all

player_chips.styles: rounded-full bg-white/10 border border-white/20 pl-1 pr-4 py-1 flex items-center gap-3
player_chips.avatar: Small circle with a generated gradient background based on player name.

timer_bar.styles: h-3 rounded-full bg-white/10 overflow-hidden w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto
timer_bar.fill: h-full bg-white transition-all duration-1000 linear. Change color to --error when under 20%.

picture_round.animation: Image starts with 'filter: blur(60px)' and interpolates to 'blur(0px)' over the round timer using Framer Motion.

podium.layout: 3 columns, middle column (1st place) is tallest. Use --primary for 1st, --secondary for 2nd, and white/20 for 3rd.

rules: Use 'spring' physics for all reveals and UI pop-ins to give an energetic game-show feel (e.g., stiffness: 300, damping: 25).
Stagger list animations (like leaderboards or player joined chips) using 'delayChildren' and 'staggerChildren'.
Number counting: Use Framer Motion to smoothly animate scores ticking up from X to Y.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on TV achieves a minimum 4.5:1 ratio against the dark background. Do not use pure transparent overlays over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (modes, start buttons, answer options, buzzer) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="answer-option-a"').
accessibility.visual_cues: Do not rely on color alone for correct/incorrect. Always include an icon (Check/X) alongside the color change.

instructions_to_main_agent.html_elements: Do not use native HTML form elements (like <select>). Use custom React/Tailwind components to ensure consistent TV and Mobile styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.tv_safe_zones: Wrap the main TV application in a container with 'p-8 md:p-12 lg:p-16' to prevent UI elements from being cut off by TV screen bezels (overscan).
instructions_to_main_agent.component_files: Create dedicated files for complex components: 'Buzzer.js', 'FocusableCard.js', 'NumberPad.js'. Note: The project uses .js files, not .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to every clickable element and state container (e.g. data-testid='tv-lobby', data-testid='phone-buzzer').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break that habit: make the UI feel like a premium Apple TV app combined with the energy of Jackbox Games.
Never center-align the whole app container. Use distinct grids and purposeful asymmetrical alignments.
Do not use dark colors as linear gradients. Use them as solid backgrounds or subtle radial blooms.
Create depth with layered elements (z-index) and glass-morphism (12-24px blur).
Ensure every state transition (Idle -> Answering -> Locked In -> Reveal) is animated.
